title: VerbEnvelope
description: The object every dispatcher verb prints with --json. The human output is a rendering of the same object. result is verb-specific; everything else is uniform so an agent can parse any verb the same way.

args.description: The parsed arguments, for the record.

ok.description: The verb completed and its own success criterion held.

exit_code.description: 0 ok; 1 collector exception; 2 hard check failed; 3 refused by a guard rail; 4 plan produced, not applied.

run_id.description: Set by collect and repair; null otherwise.

slept_seconds.description: Time spent pacing (from the clock's recorded sleeps); tells an agent how much of the wall time was rate limiting.

result.description: Verb-specific. status -> Status; check -> checks.json v2; explain -> the explain object; collect -> {summary, legs[], checks}; repair -> {plan_path, changes, applied, intervention_id}; replay -> {passed, diff, run_records, anomalies}; diff -> the diff object; doctor -> {diagnosis, confidence, evidence, playbook}.

truncated.description: Every cap that shortened this output, so an agent never mistakes a sample for the whole.
